item.title: Who is Tarique Rahman and what his win means for India
item.description: Tarique Rahman has achieved a stunning political comeback, leading the BNP to a landslide victory in Bangladesh’s national election. After 17 years in exile and acquittal of past charges, his return marks a new political era. This shift promises significant changes domestically and for India-Bangladesh relations.

item.title: GHMC committee allocates Rs 500 crore to Cyberabad, Malkajgiri Municipal corporations
item.description: Senior bureaucrat Jayesh Ranjan convened the standing committee meeting, exercising his powers as the special officer for the three corporations.

item.title: Shriram One app is addressing India’s most persistent financial gaps
item.description: The Shriram One App by Shriram Finance is aimed at translating access to tangible financial progress. The cloud-native app is built on Microsoft’s Azure platform.

item.title: Goldman Sachs assigns Buy rating on 5 defence stocks: Which ones and why?
item.description: MNC brokerage Goldman Sachs has assigned a ‘Buy’ rating on five defence sector stocks, which is breaking new ground riding new technological capability, global partnerships and growing role of private sector companies.

item.title: Noida: Car plunges into open drain in Sector 70, residents allege civic negligence
item.description: A car plunged into an open drain in Noida Sector 70 on Thursday night. Fortunately there were no injuries in the accident as the driver of the car had stepped out of the vehicle. The incident comes close on the heels of 2 similar cases, where motorists, one a car driver and another bike driver were killed after their vehicles skidded into open pits.

item.title: Ranveer Singh extortion case: Voice note linked to Lawrence Bishnoi aide?
item.description: Ranveer Singh’s alleged extortion threat case has taken a serious turn, with Mumbai Crime Branch probing a possible Lawrence Bishnoi gang link. A Rs 1 crore demand and a suspicious voice note have triggered a wider investigation. Here’s everything we know so far.

item.title: How to tackle Pakistan’s sling-arm spinner Usman Tariq? Ashwin offers unique advice to Indian batters
item.description: Former India spinner R Ashwin, who was known for his clever strategies, explained a shrewd tactic to counter the threat of Pakistan spinner Usman Tariq in the blockbuster clash on Sunday.

item.title: PlayStation State of Play February 2026: Full list of games announced, trailers and release dates
item.description: Sony’s February 2026 State of Play delivered over an hour of major PS5 announcements, surprise reveals, and new trailers. Highlights included a confirmed God of War Greek trilogy remake, a surprise 2D spin-off launch, and fresh looks at titles like Death Stranding 2, Silent Hill: Townfall, and Resident Evil Requiem.
